Flextime account, digital report book, overtime calculator & working-time record.
                100% offline, GDPR-compliant, and designed for your apprenticeship.
hero.beispielwerte_sollstunden_pausen_und_run: Sample values. Target hours, breaks and rounding come from your own settings.

main.gleitzeitkonto_digitales_berichtsheft_ue: Flextime account, digital report book & overtime calculator — free, offline, GDPR-compliant. Join more than 200 apprentices.

showcase.vier_handgriffe_und_der_tag: Four taps, and the day is logged.
showcase.kommen_pause_gehen_den_rest: Clock in, break, clock out — the app does the rest. By the end of the week the report book is almost finished.
showcase.ein_tap_auf_kommen_oder: One tap on „Clock in“ — or an NFC tag at your workstation. That is all the start takes.
showcase.die_pause_wird_abgezogen_nicht: The break is deducted, not estimated. The app knows the statutory minimum break.
showcase.mi_wartung_der_clients_im: Wed — Serviced the clients on the 2nd floor, prepared the image rollout. 8:30 h

actSteps.ein_tap_startet_den_livetracker: One tap starts the live tracker. No form, no sign-up, no waiting for a server. Prefer typing? Enter start and end by hand.
actSteps.pausen_zieht_myworklog_nach_deinen: MyWorkLog deducts breaks according to your settings — not a fixed number in the code. The statutory minimum break is built in and speaks up when it is missing.
actSteps.der_tag_wird_gegen_dein: The day is measured against your daily target, and the difference moves into your flextime account. Overtime and undertime show up right away — rounded, if your employer rounds.
actSteps.aus_den_eintraegen_der_woche: The week's entries become your training record — a PDF on the official form of your chamber. What you noted each day is already in it.

features.alles_was_azubis_fuer_die: Everything apprentices need for time tracking
features.gleitzeitkonto_berichtsheft_ueberstunden: Flextime account, report book, overtime calculator — one app for everything around your apprenticeship.
features.livetracker_manueller_eintrag_oder_nfcta: Live tracker, manual entry or an NFC tag at your workstation. Shifts, multiple jobs, vocational school days and holidays are their own entry types — whether your training is technical, commercial or industrial.
features.der_ausbildungsnachweis_entsteht_aus_dei: Your training record is built from your entries and exported as a PDF on the official form of your chamber — DIHK template, revised version or Munich.
features.deine_eintraege_bleiben_im_browser: Your entries stay in your device's browser. Backups are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before the app even offers you the file.
features.ein_service_worker_haelt_die: A service worker keeps the whole app cached. No signal in the workshop? It still runs.
features.handy_und_pc_gleichen_sich: Phone and PC sync directly over WebRTC — device to device, with nothing in between.
features.heatmaps_wochen_und_jahresansicht_progno: Heatmaps, weekly and yearly views, forecasts. Your flextime account as a picture instead of a table.

durationTooltip.woher_kommt_die_zahl: Where does this number come from?
durationTooltip.die_mittlere_dauer_einer_sitzung: The average length of a session on myworklog.de, measured by this site’s web analytics.
durationTooltip.gezaehlt_wird_der_besuch_der: What is counted is the visit to the website — not the time spent in the app itself. That runs in your browser and reports nothing outward.

engagementTooltip.sitzungen_mit_mehr_als_einer: Sessions that open more than one page
engagementTooltip.gemessen_wird_verhalten_nicht_zufriedenh: What is measured is behaviour, not satisfaction: how many sessions click onward, and how far. Nobody was surveyed, so there is no score for that here.

values.drei_entscheidungen_die_jede_weitere: Three decisions that shape every other one.
values.deine_eintraege_bleiben_im_browser: Your entries stay in the browser — no account, no advertising pixels, no profiling. The anonymous usage statistics are cookie-free and publicly viewable.
values.jede_rechnung_im_gleitzeitkonto_ist: Every calculation in the flextime account is covered by tests. Where a number is uncertain, the app says so — instead of filling in the most plausible one.
values.kostenlos_und_ohne_anmeldung_werkzeuge: Free and without sign-up. Tools for an apprenticeship should not depend on what somebody can pay.

journey.von_der_ersten_idee_bis: From the first idea until today.

jrP1.aus_dem_aerger_ueber_umstaendliche: Annoyance at clumsy time tracking at work turned into a prototype: one page that captures a working day in two taps.

jrP2.myworklog_geht_als_progressive_web: MyWorkLog goes live as a progressive web app — offline-first, no account, no server in the data path.

jrP3.regelbasierte_analysen_heatmaps_und_prog: Rule-based analyses, heatmaps and forecasts arrive — and the report book learns the official forms of the chambers.

jrP4.ueber_200_azubis_erfassen_ihre: More than 200 apprentices track their hours with MyWorkLog. Since then it has gained NFC clock-in, device sync over WebRTC and the import bridge from other tools.

team.schreibt_myworklog_neben_der_eigenen: Builds MyWorkLog alongside his own apprenticeship — and uses it every day.
